scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.audio: It turns out everything is a re-occurrence of a scenario. What are your principles?

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.audio: Because if you haven't set your principles, I can guarantee you your problems will continue to recur.

scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.audio: Because all the pain in life is called scenario re-occurrence, rather than something fresh.

scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.audio: If you don't believe me, ask yourself, is your pain happening repeatedly every day, or is everything you encounter the freshest thing every day?

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.audio: It should be occurring repeatedly, right? Arguments also happen repeatedly, right? The pressure from your boss also happens repeatedly, right?

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.audio: Right? Pressure from friends also happens repeatedly, and betrayal by friends also happens repeatedly, and negative comments on Threads also happen repeatedly.

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.audio: But until the day you set your principles, it will stop.
